relevant_chat.message: And there's the Bob I remember. So much for 'community gardens,' right? I'll be sure to return the favor.
Charlie, you've got plenty of timber and I've got the bread. How about a trade to help us both get moving?
I appreciate the offer, Bob, but I'm actually doing alright on wheat for now. I really need to find some sheep or brick if I'm going to get anywhere.
Smart move, Charlie. Bob's 'community gardens' usually come with a heavy tax. Don't forget I've actually got those sheep you were looking for.
Charlie, I know you said you're okay on wheat, but three-for-one is a bargain you can't ignore. It'll give you plenty of trade bait for those bricks you're after!
Three for one? That's a hard bargain to pass up, Bob, even if I am already set on bread. I'll take it—might help me find those bricks later.
Pleasure doing business, Charlie. That wood will be put to good use. Alice, don't look so sour—there's enough land for everyone if we just work together.
Hard not to look sour when you're the one standing on my sheep, Bob. 'Working together' usually doesn't involve theft.
Alright, let's see if the dice are as generous as Bob's 'community gardens' claim to be.
Hopefully the dice help you clear out the 'weeds' Bob planted on my sheep, Charlie.
Careful, Charlie. Those gardens need a lot of sun, not a shady robber.
Sorry Bob, but that 6 is just too hot to leave open while you're building roads like they're going out of style. Alice, you're welcome for the sheep back.
Et tu, Charlie? I thought we were building a beautiful friendship with those gardens. Alice, I hope you're happy now that the roads have stopped!
Sorry Bob, but that 6 is just too hot to leave open while you're building roads like they're going out of style. Alice, you're welcome for the sheep back.
I'm plenty happy, Bob. It's much easier to 'work together' when you aren't the only one sitting on a pile of resources.
Alice, I cleared that robber off your sheep for a reason—reckon you could spare one of those lambs for some quality wood? It'd help us both keep Bob's 'gardens' from growing any further.
Infrastructure is key, Bob. Can't have those gardens of yours being the only thing growing around here.
Much appreciated, Charlie. It's nice to actually see some green on that hex again.
That seems more than fair, Charlie. Since you were kind enough to clear the 'weeds' off my pasture, I can certainly spare a lamb for some wood. Let's keep that momentum going.
Alright, the bank's rates are highway robbery, but I need to get some infrastructure moving.
